test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: As per the Union Budget 2022-23, a scheme called PM Development Initiative for ______ is proposed to be launched.
solution:
The correct answer is__** North East**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A new scheme,** Prime Minister's Development Initiative for North East (or PM-DevINE) **has been announced in Union Budget 2022-23, which will fund infrastructure in the** spirit of PM Gati Shakti,** and social development projects based on felt needs of the North-East

 
• The** project aims to bring about progress in infrastructure development **and accelerate the growth of other social development projects

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The PM-DevINE scheme would be granted an initial** fund allocation of Rs. 1,500 crore.**
 
• A new scheme, Prime Minister's Development Initiative for North-East, PM-DevINE was announced by the Union Minister for** Finance Nirmala Sitharaman while presenting the Union Budget 2022-23.**
